caps_comment: lab arms: G20 is 20k rows, so M is above the release rule (M <= .25 of stage-1 mass, plan §6.4) by design; these caps only flag gross errors. GSM8K <= 15% of math problems is the plan's figure for the full M slice (12k problems); with only M1+M3 built (6.7k) 1700 GSM problems are ~25.4% (cap .26)
fill_comment: plan §4/§6.7: MA must match MS's math prompt characters with fresh numgen problems (valid when MS and MA are trained with the same --grouped-aux K). The 8,000-problem numgen pool leaves 3,000 fresh problems after MS's 5,000, i.e. 51% of the target; about 11.5k fresh problems (a pool of about 16.5k) are needed. min_ratio makes the build refuse until the pool is regenerated (--allow-short-fill reproduces the short pilot build)
